decisions.reason: This flagship Demeter yogurt range builds directly on the firm's established organic dairy knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and improve the product through in-house R&D.

Mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's existing cheese capabilities, giving it the absorptive capacity to assess market feedback and adjust the product, but with slightly higher uncertainty than the flagship range.
Sliced butter cheese likewise leverages the firm's related cheese-making knowledge, enabling learning from early results and continuous improvement.
